title: Nursing with Childbearing Families
description: Employ a woman and family-centered approach that attends to health inequities, material, social, and discursive conditions and the experiences of all family members to explore nursing care for childbearing families from preconception through the childbearing year. Develop the knowledge and clinical judgement needed for working with common perinatal, neonatal, rural and public health nursing situations.
notes: This course is offered in an online delivery mode.
